notes.title: Dragon’s Hoard Open Alpha Playtest is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
[h3][h2]Dragon’s Hoard Open Alpha Playtest is now LIVE!
[/h2][/h3]
Dragon’s Hoard Open Alpha Playtest is now LIVE and will be running for one-week only. Visit our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1455510/Dragons_Hoard/]Steam[/url] page to request access to our Free Playtest so you can join other fellow hoarders in testing the new additions of the. Visit our [url=https://discord.com/invite/nXmbYdeJ]Discord[/url] page to join in on the conversation and help us make Dragon’s Hoard the best experience possible.

https://twitter.com/DragonsHoard3/status/1551086067511541762

When will the Dragon’s Hoard Open Alpha Test begin?

The Alpha Play Test is now LIVE and will be running for one week. You can also tune into our [url=https://discord.com/invite/nXmbYdeJ]Discord[/url] and Twitter for more up-to-the-minute news on the game.

How can I apply for the Dragon’s Hoard Open Alpha Test?

There will be a button to apply for the “Playtest” on Dragon’s Hoard Steam Page, but you can also join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/nXmbYdeJ]Discord[/url] and reach out to us on how to join in on the fun.

When will I receive my Open Alpha Test invitation?

You will automatically qualify to access the Open Alpha Test at any time while the test is live. There will be additional opportunities for Alpha and Beta tests prior to the official launch.

Will my Open Alpha Test progress carry over to the launch of the game?

No, any progress gained during the Open Alpha Test will not carry over.

Twitter: @DragonsHoard3

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/nXmbYdeJ

notes.title: Dragon's Hoard next Alpha Test gearing up to launch at the end of July!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Fellow Hoarders!
[/b][/h1]
Dragon’s Hoard continues to be worked on and optimized by @Kreg and we wish you like the improvements made to the experience. Fight monsters, collect loot, and grow your dragon, but most importantly connect with others to have fun! If you want to join Fellow Hoarders to have the optimal play experience, ask us how on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/nXmbYdeJ]Discord[/url]!

[b]When will the Dragon’s Hoard Open Alpha Test begin?
[/b]
The start of the Alpha Test will be at the end of July, but we still haven’t decided on the specific time and date for them. Once we have more details on it, we will release another announcement to confirm the dates and provide the times in their respective time zones. You can also tune into our [url=https://discord.com/invite/nXmbYdeJ]Discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/DragonsHoard3]Twitter[/url] for more up-to-the-minute news on the game.

[b]How can I apply for the Dragon’s Hoard Open Alpha Test?
[/b]
There will be a button to apply for the "Playtest" on Dragon’s Hoard Steam Page, but you can also join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/nXmbYdeJ]Discord[/url] and reach out to us on how to join in on the fun.

[b]When will I receive my Open Alpha Test invitation?
[/b]
You will automatically qualify to access the Open Alpha Test at any time while the test is live. There will be additional opportunities for Alpha and Beta tests prior to the official launch.

[b]Will my Open Alpha Test progress carry over to the launch of the game?
[/b]
No, any progress gained during the Open Alpha Test will not carry over.

notes.notes:

Hello fellow Hoarders!

Dragon's Hoard will be playable at the Armageddon Expo on the weekend of June 10th through June 12th located in the Auckland Showgrounds (New Zealand). Dragon's Hoard creator will be in attendance and will guide you through the recent build of the game.

To tie-in with the Expo, we are anticipating having an Alpha test launch for that same weekend. Our team hopes to have local expo goers as well as people online join in and participate in the game. If you are interested in participating in the Alpha test, you can contact us through our Discover server.

Hope to see you at the Armageddon Expo if you will be in attendance!

Armageddon Expo: https://www.armageddonexpo.com/
